problems: The blind guess (rounded dome, jellyfish or lantern) does not match the intended subject. The drawing reads as an angular kite, a diamond with straight edges and a point at top and bottom, with a long tail. Nothing in the figure is rounded.
The figure is the right way up: apex at top, spine running down to the bottom point, and the string trailing off the bottom.

Stars sit roughly on the intended parts: top apex 79664 at about (279,112), torn top-right 77952 at (332,108), right wing 76440 at (370,181), bottom point 80686 at (252,262), left corner 82129 at (207,197), belly knot 82273 at (209,243), trailing knot 81852 at (243,440).
The 'left belly' star sits on the left edge of the kite rather than inside its belly, so it reads as a corner rather than a bridle knot.
The frayed end 81065 at about (258,471) and the lower bend 80047 at about (272,466) are almost on top of each other, so the cut end does not read as a separate frayed end.
Labels collide badly: 'top apex' overlaps 'torn top-right', 'left corner' runs into 'left belly', and the lower labels overlap each other and the stars. Several parts are unreadable.
The blue outline is a thin trace that hugs the gold spine lines almost exactly. It works as a faint silhouette, but it is not strong enough to read as an independent shape.
output.advice:

1. Kite body: keep the apex 79664 at about (279,112) and the bottom point 80686 at about (252,262) as the spine ends. Widen the left side so the left corner 82129 at about (207,197) and the belly knot 82273 sit inside the kite outline, not on its edge. Move 82273 about 15-20 px right, toward the centre of the body, so it reads as a belly point.
2. Silhouette: draw a filled or closed outline of the kite through these points, not just a thin trace, so the shape reads as an object and not as the gold skeleton.
3. Tail: keep the trailing knot 81852 at about (243,440). Separate the frayed end 81065 from the lower bend 80047: put the bend at about (262,460) and the frayed end at about (276,482) so the cut end is distinct, with a small splayed fray at its tip.
